description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryDao class, which interacts with the database to retrieve and manage employee directory data. It includes methods to fetch employee lists and counts based on search filters, as well as fetching individual employee records by employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Employee Directory, providing methods to query employee data based on various filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee objects matching the given search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper object configured with search filters, sorting, and pagination for employee list retrieval.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the given search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an Employee entity by their employee number, if exists.
